title: Your favourite creator has a secret rate
scenario: A travel creator you follow posts a story offering followers a private hotel rate through a “partner portal.” The story looks normal, but the portal asks you to log in with your booking-site account before showing prices.

answers.A: Check the creator’s permanent profile/site and the hotel or booking platform independently before using any partner link.
answers.B: Message the creator through a previously known channel and ask whether the story is theirs.
answers.C: Use the portal if your password manager autofills the login, because that suggests the domain is legitimate.

explanation: Creator accounts can be hijacked, and partner offers are perfect cover for credential phishing.
proTip: A familiar face can front an unfamiliar domain.
